verdict.rationale: Claude Code is itself an AI assistant embedded in the terminal/IDE/Slack/web that plans, writes, tests, and ships code end-to-end via natural-language delegation, with strong first-party docs and reinforced by community usage reports (both positive and critical) confirming it is used this way in practice. Missing for 10: no rigorous independent benchmark of task success rate beyond anecdotal hands-on reports (some of which report inconsistent reliability).
